items.title: SEC's Innovation Exemption for Tokenized Stocks
points: SEC launches 'Innovation Exemption' allowing tokenized U.S. stocks to trade on blockchain venues without traditional exchange registration, bypassing the stalled Clarity Act (proposed crypto market structure legislation) in Congress

SEC Chairman Paul Atkins announced an immediate five-year exemption allowing qualified venues to trade actual tokenized U.S. stocks (carrying voting rights and dividends) via automated market makers (decentralized trading systems matching buyers and sellers without intermediaries) on permissionless blockchains
Exemption excludes synthetic tokens that only track stock prices without ownership rights, narrowing scope to prevent speculative derivatives

SEC framed the measure as a temporary regulatory bridge while pursuing permanent rulemaking and possible Congressional legislation, signaling willingness to act unilaterally after the Clarity Act stalled in the Senate

items.title: Zcash Surge After NU7 Upgrade Vote
points: Zcash surges to $1,400, up 168% in one month, after the community voted to maintain Bitcoin-style halvings (automatic reduction of mining rewards) in its NU7 upgrade

items.title: S&P Global Expands Crypto Risk Assessment
points: S&P Global partners with OpenZeppelin to expand crypto risk assessment coverage for stablecoins and tokenized assets

items.title: Congressional Crypto Bills Beyond Clarity Act
points: House committee advances a Bitcoin reserve bill stripped of Federal Reserve funding routes and transparency requirements, passing on a party-line vote
Stand With Crypto advocacy group announced it will electorally score senators' votes on the failed Clarity Act, threatening political payback in upcoming elections

House committee also passed a separate crypto tax bill that would make crypto transaction fees tax-exempt and restrict loss harvesting (selling assets at a loss to reduce taxable income) on quick repurchases
Multiple legislative pathways are advancing despite the Clarity Act's failure, indicating bipartisan interest in piecemeal crypto regulation

items.title: Market Reactions and Asset Performance
points: Bitcoin holds $76,667, up 1.2% in 24 hours, as broader crypto markets stabilize following Federal Reserve decision volatility
Ethereum faces a critical technical level at $2,460, with 62% market probability favoring a $3K pump versus 38% for a $1.5K dump

Ethereum's structural support strengthened by Bitmine's $68 million purchase of 27,180 ETH, bringing its holdings to 5.96 million tokens (nearly 5% of total ETH supply); chairman Tom Lee called it Q3's best-performing macro asset

items.title: JPMorgan's Bitcoin vs. Gold Analysis
points: JPMorgan analysts project Bitcoin could outperform gold if demand for hedging through Bitcoin ETFs (exchange-traded funds that track Bitcoin's price) declines from current levels
Bank identifies ETF hedging demand as the primary headwind currently limiting Bitcoin's outperformance relative to gold
Analysis suggests institutional adoption through ETFs has created an artificial price ceiling that could lift as market conditions change
Bitcoin ETF market shows substantial growth potential according to industry experts, signaling institutional investor appetite remains strong

headlines: JPMorgan analysts project Bitcoin could outperform gold if demand for hedging through Bitcoin ETFs (exchange-traded funds that track Bitcoin's price) declines from current levels.

Current ETF hedging demand is temporarily capping Bitcoin's upside; removal of this pressure could unlock significant price appreciation.
